verdict.rationale: Better Stack is a telemetry and observability platform that ingests logs, metrics, traces and errors, so controlling data retention and deletion applies to it. The evidence pack documents no retention periods, retention settings or data-deletion controls. The monitor DELETE API endpoint removes monitor configuration, not stored data, and the reporting data export is a different feature; both are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
